title: NYC Garba For-A-Cause
description: We're back again this year with a space thats BIGGER & BETTER than before!
long_description:
We're back again this year with a space thats BIGGER & BETTER than before!

About this Event

Want to Garba in Manhattan?
Wish you could Garba for a cause?

Fear not! Join us to raise money for Sakhi all while celebrating the holiday season with garba, dandiya and Bollywood dancing in Manhattan!

Date: Saturday, Oct 24th 6:30-1130 pm
Time: Doors open at 6:30pm
Garba/Dandiya from 6:30 to 1030pm
Bollywood Party from 1030pm to 1130 pm
Venue: 873 Broadway 2nd Floor NYC, NY 10010
Attire: Traditional Indian wear is encouraged - bring out your best kurtas and chaniya cholis!
Live music by DJ PJ
Delicious Food Available For Purchase
Special performance by BollywoodFunkNYC
No alcohol on premises
Your ticket money goes to Sakhi as a Donation
(You may make an extra donation when buying your ticket)

Ticket pricing:
Early bird (entry before 730 pm) - $30
Regular (entry after 730 pm at any time) - $35
Bollywood Dancing Only Entry (entry after 10 pm) - $15
Add +$20 to any ticket price for a plate of food and a drink
Food & Drinks available for purchase at venue as well

Please reach out to Crank It Up A Naach for sponsorship and inquiries at Y3JhbmtpdHVwYW5hYWNoOCB8IGdtYWlsICEgY29t or message on instagram @crankitupanaach

Follow for future events!

Want to Join But Don't Know How to Garba? Still feel free to come and have a good time - OR come join one of our garba classes! Details on our instagram page @crankitupanaach

For information on Sakhi:
Sakhi for South Asian Survivors exists to represent the South Asian and Indo-Caribbean diaspora in a survivor-led movement for gender justice and to honor the collective and inherent power of all survivors of violence.
Sakhi directly works with survivors of gender based violence (GBV) and provides them needed resources and support.

48% of South Asians have experienced at least one form of gender based violence. 41% witnessed GBV in their households and 25% of children experienced child sexual abuse. GBV is the leading cause of homeless
